description: This file defines a UI widget for toggling full logging mode within a Java application. It creates a panel with a checkbox that, when toggled, sends a command to the CommandQueue to enable or disable full logging.

classes.name: LogModeWidget
classes.description: A UI component providing a checkbox to toggle full logging mode, communicating the state change through the CommandQueue.

methods.name: LogModeWidget
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget, setting up the UI and the action listener for the checkbox.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel containing the checkbox UI component.
